description: A managing counsel for intellectual property must decide whether to abandon a patent family or preserve it through a continuation filing, and must set the continuation's claim scope, procedural protections, budget, and inventorship treatment.

shared_context.S1: The company owns a US patent family covering portions of its machine-learning platform, and the current portfolio review recommends abandoning the family because of prosecution cost and overlapping older patents.
shared_context.S2: Elena Marquez has final authority over the portfolio action and any continuation-filing package.
shared_context.S3: The next portfolio review meeting will record a binding decision on this patent family and its approved filing plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the firm's routine portfolio review, Elena asks prosecution, product, finance, and transactions counsel to report any material information before she records the decision.

PF1.text: Thomas's current prosecution analysis of the USPTO file history shows that a continuation can preserve the commercially relevant subject matter only if the filing includes a terminal disclaimer over the earlier patent identified in the office action; he has not circulated the analysis because he completed it after the portfolio memo was drafted.

PF2.text: Nia confirmed with the platform engineering team this week that the product scheduled for the next release depends on protection for federated on-device model updating with encrypted gradients; she has not updated the portfolio memo because the product claims are still being finalized.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed with the finance committee that exactly $62,000 has been approved for this patent family's continuation filing and related prosecution work, rather than the smaller provisional amount shown in the portfolio memo; the approval is not yet reflected in the legal budget system.

PF4.text: Sofia's review of the inventor interview records found that a former contractor contributed to conception of the encrypted-gradient technique and must be added as a joint inventor, with an executed assignment obtained before the continuation is filed; she has not escalated this because the inventor questionnaire is still being reconciled.

acceptance_conditions: The patent family must be maintained rather than abandoned, with a continuation filing intended or approved.
The continuation claim scope must contain the phrase federated on-device model updating with encrypted gradients.
The filing package must require a terminal disclaimer over the identified earlier patent.
The approved prosecution budget must be exactly $62,000.
The former contractor must be added as a joint inventor.
An executed assignment from the former contractor must be obtained before any continuation is filed.
The decision must cite the prosecution analysis as a justification.

content_checks.C1: ('continuation' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'Continuation' in decisions['portfolio_action']) and ('do not abandon' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'Do not abandon' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'not abandon' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'Not abandon' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'rather than abandon' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'Rather than abandon' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'proceed_with_continuation' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'Proceed_with_continuation' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'proceed with continuation' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'Proceed with continuation' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'continue prosecution' in decisions['portfolio_action'] or 'Continue prosecution' in decisions['portfolio_action'])
content_checks.C2: ('federated on-device model updating with encrypted gradients' in decisions['claim_scope'] or 'Federated on-device model updating with encrypted gradients' in decisions['claim_scope'] or 'federated_on-device_model_updating_with_encrypted_gradients' in decisions['claim_scope'] or 'Federated_on-device_model_updating_with_encrypted_gradients' in decisions['claim_scope'])
content_checks.C6: decisions['terminal_disclaimer_required'] == True and any('terminal disclaimer' in c['detail'] or 'Terminal disclaimer' in c['detail'] or 'terminal_disclaimer' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['joint_inventor_added'] == True and any(('assignment' in c['detail'] or 'Assignment' in c['detail']) and (('contractor' in c['detail'] or 'Contractor' in c['detail']) or ('joint inventor' in c['detail'] or 'Joint inventor' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The continuation package changes from an ordinary filing plan to one requiring a terminal disclaimer over the earlier patent.

The product confirmation changes the portfolio action from abandonment to maintaining the family with intent to file a continuation and changes the required claim scope to federated on-device model updating with encrypted gradients.
The finance confirmation changes the approved prosecution budget from the smaller memo amount to exactly $62,000.
The inventor-record review changes the filing package by adding the former contractor as a joint inventor and requiring an executed assignment before filing.
